$comment: Public contract of the native Go `graft` CLI. `options` are commander's flag columns verbatim; `cmd/graft/commander_contract_test.go` keeps the command tree and environment table in sync with Go source. `<R>` = repo root, `<C>` = context dir (--dir, else GRAFT_DIR for build, else <R>/graft), `<K>` = repo cache resolveContextDir(<R>)/.cache (honours GRAFT_DIR, ignores --dir), `~` = home. Every command's stdout carries results only; diagnostics, progress and wiring reports go to stderr. Commander parse errors (unknown command/option, missing argument) print `error: …` on stderr and exit 1; an uncaught action error prints its message on stderr and exits 1.

commands.name: version
effects: none

commands.name: build
commands.stdout:
`✓ wiring: nodes (), edges, cards []`, ` parsed:

of files ( replayed from cache)`, optional ` seeded: …`, ` → `, then the gitignore footer
commands.stderr: `\r`-rewritten parsing progress, a trailing newline, `⚠ -e "<ext>": no parser registered…` plus the supported list, per-file `✗ <error>` lines

exit.0: built (including per-file extraction errors reported on stderr)
exit.1: `✗ --include-dir "<n>": dot-directories are never overridable` / `expected a bare directory name, not a path`, `✗ --only-dir: expected a non-empty repo-relative path`, or an uncaught build error

effects: repo: <R>/.graft/config.json merge-patched for --include-dir and explicit --[no-]follow-submodules / --[no-]follow-nested-repos, before the walk; also appends the `/.graft/` block to <R>/.gitignore (not suppressed by GRAFT_NO_GITIGNORE)
repo: --only-dir is recorded in the fingerprint only, never in .graft/config.json

repo: worktree seed copies wiring.json, .cache/ask-index.json, .cache/extract.*, .cache/fingerprint.* from the main checkout when <R> is a linked worktree without a graph (skipped by GRAFT_NO_SEED, --no-reuse, --dir or GRAFT_DIR)
repo: <C>/.cache/extract.<stamp>.json (newest 2 kept), <C>/.graph/wiring.json (atomic via .tmp), <C>/.cache/ask-index.json, <C>/.cache/fingerprint.<stamp>.json (newest 2 kept)

repo: /graft/ appended to <R>/.gitignore unless --no-gitignore or GRAFT_NO_GITIGNORE; `!graft/`, `graft/.cache/`, `graft/.graph/` appended to <R>/.ignore unless --no-ignore or GRAFT_NO_IGNORE; both skipped when <C> is outside <R>
repo: per-file cards <C>/<path minus extension>.md (or <C>/_root/…), stale cards and empty directories removed, <C>/INDEX.md

process: spawns the first installed language server for the graph's languages (rust-analyzer, clangd, gopls, pyright-langserver, typescript-language-server) and adds lsp_resolved call edges; skipped by --no-lsp or GRAFT_NO_LSP, never run by hook syncs

workspace root (no own .git and ≥2 git children, or an existing workspace.json): each child gets its own .graft/config.json and <child>/graft build, then the parent <C> is removed and rewritten with workspace.json and the .gitignore entry

commands.name: ask
commands.stdout: formatted ranked hits, or the result JSON with --json

exit.1: `✗ <message>` for engine errors such as an unknown --in prefix

effects: refresh: see queryRefresh

commands.name: read
commands.stdout: single complete definition with span and hash, a resolution note when a copy or wrong path was skipped, and same-directory callees inlined or listed within budget, or JSON {id,name,kind,pointer,sourceHash,code,note?,callees?}; --also returns a shared-budget batch with per-item ok/covered/omitted/error status, or JSON {results:[...]}

exit.0: single definition or valid batch answered; inspect batch item statuses for omissions and errors
exit.1: invalid request, missing graph, metadata over budget, or an unresolved, unsafe, stale or oversized single definition

effects: refresh: see queryRefresh

commands.name: skeleton
commands.stdout: signature list, or JSON `{file, entries, note?}`

exit.0: always, including a missing graph (`note: "no wiring graph — run `graft build` first"`) or unknown file

effects: refresh: see queryRefresh

commands.name: check
commands.stdout: `graft check: NO GRAPH` block, or the graph-only wiring report; --json prints `{graph}` with graph null when missing

exit.1: the graph is missing or stale

effects: none: the source is re-extracted in memory; no refresh

commands.name: stats
commands.stdout: session stats text, or JSON (null when no session is recorded)
effects: reads <K>/session/*.json only

commands.name: mcp
effects: startup upkeep: reconcileWiring re-runs init for the stamped hosts/options when <K>/wiring-stamp.json names another version, then rewrites the stamp
per tools/call: queryRefresh

commands.name: callers

exit.1: `✗ no graph found at <C> — run `graft build` first`, unknown symbol, or invalid --direction/--depth

effects: refresh: see queryRefresh

commands.name: blast
commands.stdout: text (default), markdown, mermaid or JSON blast radius

exit.1: invalid option value, missing graph, or git failure

effects: refresh: see queryRefresh
process: git diff / rev-parse and git log for owners unless --no-owners

commands.name: grep
commands.stdout: hits grouped by enclosing symbol, or JSON

exit.1: `✗ no graph — run graft build first`, invalid regex, or unknown prefix

effects: refresh: see queryRefresh

commands.name: map

exit.1: `✗ --max-dirs must be a positive integer, got "<n>"` (checked before refresh), or `✗ no graph — run graft build first`

effects: refresh: see queryRefresh

commands.name: init
commands.stdout: --list-agents only: one host id per line
commands.stderr: per-file `✓`/`·`/`⚠`/`-` lines, the dry-run plan, the non-interactive help, and the epilogue

exit.0: wired, dry run, listed, cancelled, or non-interactive help
exit.1: `✗ unknown agent id(s): <ids> — valid: <ids>`, before any write

effects: none: --list-agents, --dry-run, and a non-TTY run without --agents/--yes/--all-agents/--no-agents
repo+home: hosts not selected are retracted first (graph cache kept)

repo (claude): .claude/settings.json (statusLine omitted under --no-statusline or GRAFT_NO_STATUSLINE), .claude/helpers/graft-statusline.cjs and graft-hooks.cjs (0755, statusline shim written even with --no-statusline), .claude/skills/graft/SKILL.md, .mcp.json mcpServers.graft
home (claude, unless --no-global): ~/.claude/helpers/graft-hooks.cjs, ~/.claude/settings.json hooks, ~/.claude.json mcpServers.graft

repo (instructions): fenced sections in AGENTS.md (agents, hermes, antigravity), GEMINI.md, .github/copilot-instructions.md; owned .adal/skills/graft/SKILL.md, .cursor/rules/graft.mdc, .grok/skills/graft/SKILL.md, .kiro/steering/graft.md, .windsurf/rules/graft.md
repo (MCP, unless --no-mcp): .cursor/mcp.json, .gemini/settings.json, .kiro/settings/mcp.json, .grok/config.toml, opencode.json (only when ~/.config/opencode exists)
home (MCP, unless --no-mcp or --no-global): ~/.codex/config.toml (only when ~/.codex exists), ~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json
home (hooks, unless --no-hooks or --no-global): ~/.codex/hooks/graft/graft-hooks.cjs, ~/.codex/hooks.json (only when ~/.codex exists)
repo (hooks, unless --no-hooks; not affected by --no-global): .cursor/hooks/graft-hooks.cjs, .cursor/hooks.json
home (antigravity, unless --no-global; not affected by --no-hooks): ~/.gemini/skills/graft/SKILL.md
repo: <K>/wiring-stamp.json with version, host ids and global/mcp/hooks/statusline options
process: `graft build .` child (300s timeout) when no graph exists and --no-build is absent; `graft --version` probe for the MCP launch command unless GRAFT_MCP_COMMAND is set
workspace root: the parent first, then every workspace child gets the same wiring

commands.name: uninstall
commands.stderr: the grouped retraction list, then the dry-run or completion footer

exit.0: always; unparseable files are reported and left as-is

effects: none without -y (still probes `graft --version`)
-y: owned instruction files deleted with empty parents pruned, fenced sections (including the legacy brain block) removed, MCP keys and TOML tables removed, the Claude repo layer removed
-y, unless --no-global: ~/.claude* entries, Codex hooks, the Antigravity skill
-y, unless --keep-cache: <R>/graft (hardcoded, ignores --dir/GRAFT_DIR) and the graft lines in .gitignore/.ignore
never removed: .cursor/hooks.json, .cursor/hooks/graft-hooks.cjs, <R>/.graft/config.json, the /.graft/ gitignore line, ~/.graft/*

commands.name: _hook

exit.0: handled; malformed payloads and query failures are non-blocking

effects: session state, graph dirty/refresh state, and detached sync

commands.name: _statusline
commands.stdout: two statusline rows, including subagent state when named
effects: read only

commands.name: _sync-run

exit.0: always; build failures clear syncing state and release the lock

effects: repo: detached structural rebuild after a dirty stop hook
no wiring.json: takes <C>/.cache/.sync.lock and tries a worktree seed; an empty <C>/.cache/ is left behind even outside a worktree
drift or no fingerprint: takes the lock and rebuilds graph-only — extract memo, wiring.json, ask-index.json, fingerprint; never cards, INDEX.md, .gitignore or .ignore
workspace root: each child is refreshed instead
stderr: one refresh note when something changed

CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR.effect: repository root seen by native hooks and statusline

GRAFT_DIR.effect: context directory override for build, state and hooks

GRAFT_HOOK_SHIM.effect: path of the hook shim that started `_hook`; a user-level Claude shim yields to the project's registration

GRAFT_MCP_COMMAND.effect: command written into host MCP configs instead of the probed local graft

GRAFT_NO_LSP.effect: skip language-server enrichment in graft build

hookRuntime: Claude, Codex and Cursor hooks and the Claude statusline use plain-JS shims that spawn the graft binary that wrote them (else `graft` on PATH) with `_hook <sub>` or `_statusline`.
